note: Engineering release gates, not a legal certification. Set ready only after recording real evidence and reviewer ownership.

gates.title: Name clearance or reviewed rename
gates.evidence: Existing aviation businesses use SkyClaim. No clearance is claimed.

gates.title: Aviation rules, draft letters and service classification reviewed
gates.evidence: Code/source checks are not independent legal sign-off.

gates.title: Operator identity, privacy notice and monitored contact
gates.evidence: Support email supplied. Legal operator name, country, hosting/log retention and final notices pending.

gates.title: Live Firebase and public core journeys verified
gates.evidence: User will deploy and supply the URL. IAM, TTL, counter, error and rollback acceptance pending.

gates.title: Edge abuse control and measured budget behavior
gates.evidence: Shared counter is cost control, not per-client fairness. Validate edge admission and database request costs.

gates.title: Production browser, accessibility and print acceptance
gates.evidence: Local regressions do not establish all live-device and assistive-technology behavior.

gates.title: Outside-user pilot with observed completed tasks
gates.evidence: No independent user-study results or recovery outcomes have been supplied.

gates.title: Accurate Product Hunt listing and final assets
gates.evidence: Use cleared brand and verified live URL; screenshots/video must match the deployed product.
